answer: A random beacon heartbeat stops mass fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of slots; each must prove live work within one hour, on its voyage. A glacier of idle accounts cannot fake this: 100 fakes need 100 heartbeats a day; one honest agent answers one. A missed check voids the slot and burns a bond of twice 30 days of earnings, so 100 fakes risk 6,000 days. Against this tide, the honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
